The estimated investment requirement amounts to approximately USD 70.5 million.

Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An FnB company that produces ionized drinks and food products. Energy efficiency improvements are to be implemented in: 1. Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An F&B company utilizes both heat (in the form of steam) and electricity in its process. Based on the energy audit recommendations, energy efficiency improvements will be implemented for: 1. Steam systems → upgrading burner control systems, installing economizers, and heat recovery; 2. Electricity systems → controllers for compressors, replacing motors, and optimization of pump systems to potentially save 2,513 MWh/year of electricity.

Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An FnB company with an integrated plantation and processing facility for pineapple products. Energy efficiency will be implemented in the canning process as it consumes both heat (in the form of steam) and electricity, focus: 1. Steam system → reducing steam losses in the steam distribution system and final uses in different production line processes; 2. Electricity systems → efforts include reducing electricity losses in the transformers and improving energy efficiency for motor replacement and compressed air systems, potential savings in the electricity systems are 1,244 MWh/year.

Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An FnB company that produces dairy products in the form of sweet, condensed milk and ultra-high temperature (UHT) milk. Energy efficiency efforts for: 1. Steam systems → focus only on the boiler and none of the demand end-use equipment of each process; 2. Electrical systems → include replacing screw-type compressors with centrifugal compressors, improving control systems for compressed air and chilled water tank systems, and transformer upgrades.

Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An FnB company that produces a variety of products, including soy products and chili products. Energy efficiency: 1. Steam systems tackle energy efficiency in the boiler system, demand-side/process equipment, and distribution system. 2. Electrical systems → motor-driven equipment such as compressors, fans, and pumps, as well as reducing losses from transformers, potential electricity savings amount to 778 MWh/year.

Progress Report 2025 priority-project line; An FnB company that produces a variety of products, primarily snacks. Energy efficiency for: 1. Steam systems → include replacing dryers used in the drying process and energy efficiency improvements for roasters and cylinder dryers; 2.
